description.value: Indian Rasoi Curry House & Pizzeria is an Abbotsford restaurant serving Indian cuisine and pizza, with a menu that spans butter chicken and naan to fusion items like a Vegetable Noodle Tikki Burger. Located on South Fraser Way, it operates as a fast-casual spot offering both in-house and online ordering with pickup and delivery. It could serve as a meal stop for cyclists passing through the Abbotsford corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active, provides a phone number (604) 556-7560 not in OSM, and explicitly lists pickup and delivery ordering. A 'Vegetable Noodle Tikki Burger' on the menu confirms at least one vegetarian option. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null.
